en: Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor associated with a root ... (Abbreviated. In the case of the root condition there are fifteen;
in the object condition, nine; in the predominance condition, nine ... pe ... in the resultant condition, nine ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition, fifteen.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor dissociated from a root ... (Abbreviated.)
In the case of cause-condition (hetu-paccaya), there are twenty-four; ... pe ... in the case of resultant-condition (vipāka-paccaya), nine; ... pe ...
in the case of non-disappearance-condition (avigata-paccaya), twenty-four. Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause and also not rootless; ... pe ...
dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor rootless and also not non-root-cause; ... pe ... dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause and also dissociated from root-cause.

Dependent on ... [and so forth] ... dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor dissociated from a root and is also not accompanied by a root ... (Abbreviated. In the case of roots, twenty-four;
... in the case of resultants, nine; ... in the case of non-disappearance, twenty-four.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome, nor a root, nor accompanied by a root ...

Dependent on a state that is unwholesome, without root, and not rootless … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are twenty-four … pe … under the resultant condition there are nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition there are twenty-four.
